fullPassage: The recent "cycling as a lifestyle" craze has expressed itself in an increase in the number of active cyclists and in growth of cycling club membership in several European, American, Australian and Asian urban areas. It has also been accompanied by a symbolic reinterpretation of the bicycle. After the bicycle had been associated with poverty for many years, expensive recreational bicycles or recreationally-inspired commuting bicycles have suddenly become aspirational products in urban environments. In present times, cycling has become an activity which is also performed for its demonstrative value, its role in identity construction and its effectiveness in impressing others and signaling social status. To a certain extent, cycling has turned into a symbolic marker of the well-off. Obviously, value-laden consumption behavior is by no means limited to cycling. However, the link with identity construction and conspicuous consumption has become particularly manifest in the case of cycling.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: accompanying → accompanied: 수동태 현재완료(has been + p.p.)에서 과거분사 accompanied가 올바름.
det.analysis:
① expressed — 'The craze has expressed itself'에서 능동태 현재완료. 올바름 ✅

② accompanying → accompanied — 'It has also been accompanied by'에서 has been + p.p. 수동태 구조. 현재분사 accompanying은 수동태에 부적합 ←정답

③ associated — 'the bicycle had been associated with poverty'에서 과거완료 수동태. 올바름 ✅

④ performed — 'an activity which is also performed for'에서 수동태 is + p.p. 올바름 ✅
det.tip: have/has been + p.p. = 현재완료 수동태. accompanying(현재분사) ≠ accompanied(과거분사)

det.analysis:

det.korean: what → which: 선행사 'an activity' 뒤에 관계대명사 which가 적절.
det.analysis:
① growth — 'in growth of cycling club membership'에서 전치사 in 뒤 명사. 올바름 ✅

② become — 'have suddenly become aspirational products'에서 현재완료 have + p.p. become의 과거분사는 become과 동형. 올바름 ✅

③ what → which — 'an activity which is also performed'에서 선행사 activity가 있으므로 which 사용. what은 선행사를 포함하므로 선행사 있으면 불가 ←정답

det.korean: 비싼 레저용 자전거가 도시에서 '열망의 대상이 되는(aspirational)' 제품이 되었다. dispensable(없어도 되는)은 문맥과 반대.
det.analysis:
① increase(증가) — 자전거 열풍이 이용자 수 증가로 나타남. 적절 ✅

② dispensable(없어도 되는) → aspirational(열망의 대상이 되는) — 비싼 자전거가 열망의 대상이 된 맥락. '없어도 되는'은 열망과 정반대 ←정답

③ conspicuous(과시적인) — 정체성 구축과 과시적 소비. 적절 ✅

④ manifest(분명한) — 연관성이 분명해짐. 적절 ✅
det.tip: aspirational(열망의 대상이 되는) ↔ dispensable(없어도 되는, 불필요한)

questions.passage: The recent "cycling as a lifestyle" craze has expressed itself in an increase in the number of active cyclists and in growth of cycling club membership in several European, American, Australian and Asian urban areas. It has also been accompanied by a symbolic reinterpretation of the bicycle. After the bicycle had been associated with poverty for many years, expensive recreational bicycles or recreationally-inspired commuting bicycles have suddenly become aspirational products in urban environments. In present times, cycling has become an activity which is also performed for its demonstrative value, its role in identity construction and its effectiveness in impressing others and signaling social status. To a certain extent, cycling has turned into <u>a symbolic marker of the well-off</u>. Obviously, value-laden consumption behavior is by no means limited to cycling. However, the link with identity construction and conspicuous consumption has become particularly manifest in the case of cycling.
